{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
# Replace '999999.99' with NaN for QA orders
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
completed_df = df[(df['revenue'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = completed_df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

# Find the channel with highest total revenue
max_channel = channel_revenue.loc[channel_revenue['revenue'].idxmax()]

# Print results
print(channel_revenue)
print(f"Channel with highest revenue: {max_channel['channel']} with ${max_channel['revenue']:,.2f}")"}
